title: Identification of a New Family of Prenylated Volatile Sulfur Compounds in Cannabis Revealed by Comprehensive Two-Dimensional Gas Chromatography
note: Peer-reviewed volatile-compound study coauthored by Josh Del Rosso. It describes OG Kush as strongly pungent and fuel-like and associates that profile with high beta-myrcene and beta-caryophyllene. Used as corroboration, not as proof that every OG Kush lot shares one fixed terpene profile.
